name: std::chrono::get_leap_second_info
intro: Obtains a std::chrono::leap_second_info whose is_leap_second and elapsed indicate whether ut is during a positive leap second insertion and the sum of leap seconds between 1 January 1970 and ut, respectively.
summary: Obtains a std::chrono::leap_second_info whose is_leap_second and elapsed indicate whether ut is during a positive leap second insertion and the sum of leap seconds between 1 January 1970 and ut, respectively.
